title: NOBLE PARK CRICKET CLUB
tickerText:
The Noble Park Cricket Club is affiliated with the VSDCA (4 Senior Turf Teams) and the DDCA (junior cricket from 9 year old to 18 years old ) and run a Woolworths Blast program for Children aged 5-9 years of age. The Club plays and trains at Noble Park Reserve at Moodemere St Noble Park. They have excellent playing and training facilities. The Club is an inclusive club and everyone is welcome at Noble Park Cricket Club.​

Club Song
We are the boys from Noble Park

We wear the colours Blue & Gold,

And we will always fight for victory,

Until the last over’s been bowled

One for all and all for one

We play to win and have some fun

Go Noble, Go Noble,

There is no club we fear

Premiers we’ll be this year
